description: Super Micro Computer, Inc. is a Silicon Valley-based provider of total information technology solutions which address demanding workloads from the enterprise and cloud to the intelligent edge, delivering rack-scale solutions optimized for various workloads including artificial intelligence and high-performance computing where acceleration is critical, and additionally offering an extensive portfolio of server and storage solutions for enterprise data centers, cloud service providers and edge computing applications such as 5G Telco, Retail and embedded. During fiscal year 2026 it advanced its transformation into a total data center infrastructure provider through its Data Center Building Block Solutions, an integrated offering that delivers complete, modular AI infrastructure from validated components and sub-systems, ranging from individual GPUs and networking switches to complete racks, site infrastructure, management software and professional services, complementing its Total IT Solutions.
